class: Any value a user saves that only the screen showing it reads back, while the code that acts (a rule, a worker, a job) reads a different source, so the setting looks honoured and changes nothing.
mechanism: The profit rule (T-07) read only the rule set's value; the trade's saved plan Target was read by the plan screen alone.

first_seen.where: paper trades, strategy 141 and strategy 148 (GC-ICFIX issue 1)
first_seen.evidence: Strategy 141: plan target 1 %, profit Rs 32-49, nothing fired. After the fix, background alert record 303 on generated prices: strategy 148, T-07, value 21.0526, threshold 1.0000.

fix: with_plan_target at the one door resolve (backend/ofo_app/adjustment_check.py), used by the page route and the background watcher; any saved Target acts; an empty Target per ADR-305.

detection.note: Unguarded: no named check is confirmed to cover the class; the proof was one real run, not a standing check. Record 303 is the proof run.
